The '''Tulpaa tribe''' was a tribe of enlightened [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] that lived on [[Tulpaa]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Rakatan Archipelago]]. The Tulpaa tribe, along with the [[Makatak tribe]], were the two most advanced tribes of Rakata following the collapse of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], and they competed against each other for resources and technology. This tribe was led by [[Ruthic]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] warrior-priest.
